description: Log the shots of an Editor project after the customer said go to the quoted price: numbers every clip on the video lane (SH001 …) with timeline and source in/out, then Gemini watches each shot (charged per shot: 3 tokens a second, 90 at least) and writes its description, shot size, angle, subjects, setting, action, objects, sound and a suggested label onto the Storyboard card. Works through the list within one call; when done is false, call again to carry on.

project_id.description: The Editor project id (list_editor_projects). Omit for your latest project.

relog.description: true = read every shot again (charged again), e.g. after the footage changed.

track.description: The video lane to log, default V1.

name: log_shots
title: Log the Shots
